channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: 6 Detroit Lions Make ESPN’s Top-100 MVP List for 2025
item.description: The Detroit Lions placed six players on ESPN’s top-100 MVP candidates list for 2025, proving the franchise’s elite core remains intact.

item.title: Jaden Ivey Trade Buzz Grows as Pistons Eye Former Top 5 Pick
item.description: Jaden Ivey trade rumors are heating up as the Detroit Pistons reportedly listen to offers. Here’s why Detroit could consider moving the former No. 5 pick.

item.title: Gennings Dunker Could Be Detroit’s Next Interior Enforcer
item.description: Gennings Dunker looks like a perfect Detroit Lions fit, but not as Taylor Decker’s replacement. Here’s why the Iowa lineman projects best inside as a future Graham Glasgow successor.

item.title: Lions’ Coaching Staff Suddenly Feels Very Relevant to Ben Johnson’s 2026 Plans
item.description: Ben Johnson may look to the Detroit Lions for his next offensive coordinator, with Drew Petzing and Scottie Montgomery emerging as intriguing Bears targets.

item.title: Detroit Tigers, Tarik Skubal Arbitration Hearing: Date and Details
item.description: The Detroit Tigers and Tarik Skubal face a precedent-setting arbitration hearing that could reshape MLB salaries after a record-breaking $13 million gap.

item.title: New Report Explains How Brad Holmes Outmaneuvered Division Rival in NFL Draft
item.description: New reporting reveals the Vikings wanted Jameson Williams before trading the pick to Detroit, allowing Brad Holmes and the Lions to capitalize on a major miscalculation.

item.title: Detroit Lions 2026 Opponent to Play in NFL Season-Opener in Paris
item.description: One of the Detroit Lions’ 2026 opponents will open the NFL season in Paris as the Saints host the league’s first-ever regular season game in France.

item.title: Levi Onwuzurike Injury Triggers Contract Tolling for Detroit Lions
item.description: Levi Onwuzurike’s season ended before it began, but a CBA provision allows the Detroit Lions to carry his contract into the 2026 season.

item.title: What Super Bowl Betting Odds Say About the 2025-26 NFL Playoffs
item.description: Super Bowl betting odds provide an early framework for how the 2025–26 NFL playoffs are expected to take shape. As the postseason nears, Super Bowl bets increasingly reflect which teams are viewed as legitimate championship contenders rather than long-shot participants.…

item.title: Jared Goff Explains What Will Change Under Drew Petzing
item.description: Jared Goff praised new Lions OC Drew Petzing as a “home run hire” and explained what offensive changes Detroit could make in 2026.
